subject: Mathematics
objectives:
Students will understand the relationship between fractions and decimals
Students will convert fractions to decimals and vice versa
activities:
Introduction to decimal notation
Practice converting simple fractions
Group work on mixed problems

subject: Science
objectives:
Students will identify the stages of the water cycle
Students will explain evaporation and condensation
activities:
Water cycle diagram drawing
Evaporation experiment
Discussion on local weather patterns
homework: Observe and record weather for one week

Students will write a short story with beginning, middle, and end
Students will use descriptive language
activities:
Story structure discussion
Brainstorming story ideas
Individual writing time
Peer sharing
